plan: Price equals my value ($31), so staying in risks a loss if I win at this or higher price. Dropping out guarantees zero profit, which is better than a potential negative outcome.

My value is $22. At price $21.5, staying in would only yield $0.5 profit if I win now, and further increases quickly turn unprofitable. Given two other bidders remain, risk of overpaying is high. I'll drop out to avoid negative profit.
At price $40, staying in would mean paying at least $40.5 if I win, which exceeds my value of $40, guaranteeing a loss. Dropping out now ensures zero profit rather than a negative outcome.
